related.title: Pioneer 深空探測計畫
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付延遲表、指令狀態機與重送條件，全部為離線演練。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver delay table,command-state machine and retry conditions for offline rehearsal only.
related.difference: 估算非對稱熱輻射的反衝加速度，檢查微小系統力如何累積成追蹤殘差。
related.differenceEn: Estimate recoil acceleration from asymmetric thermal radiation and examine accumulation of small systematic forces.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先算秒再換小時，於時間線標 16.6667 與 33.3333 h。
先求 F=2×10⁻⁷ N，再除質量，核對 W/c 的力單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate seconds,convert to hours and mark 16.6667 and 33.3333 h on the timeline.
Calculate F=2×10⁻⁷ N,divide by mass and verify that W/c has force units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Viking 火星登陸計畫
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付延遲表、指令狀態機與重送條件，全部為離線演練。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver delay table,command-state machine and retry conditions for offline rehearsal only.
related.difference: 用對照扣除與不確定度傳播說明「有訊號」和「有生命」是不同命題。
related.differenceEn: Use control subtraction and uncertainty propagation to distinguish a signal from evidence of life.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先算秒再換小時，於時間線標 16.6667 與 33.3333 h。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成樣本反應 12±2 單位，滅活對照 7±2 單位，兩個 ± 均為獨立 1σ。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：z=(12−7)/sqrt(2²+2²)。 結果約 1.76777 σ。獨立量測相減時方差相加；顯著差值只能排除指定零假設，不能唯一識別機制。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate seconds,convert to hours and mark 16.6667 and 33.3333 h on the timeline.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic sample response is 12±2 units and inactivated control 7±2 units; uncertainties are independent 1σ. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: z=(12−7)/sqrt(2²+2²). Result ≈ 1.76777 σ. Independent subtraction adds variances; a significant difference rejects a specified null, not every alternative mechanism.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
